drafts.text:
I don't trust myself once the itch shows up. Not for one more second.
So I stopped trying to out-willpower it. Set the daily loss limit to auto-lock the account before I ever get the chance to prove I can't control myself.
Discipline isn't fighting the urge. It's removing your own hands from the wheel before the urge gets loud.
What's the guardrail you had to build because you knew you couldn't trust yourself in the moment?
drafts.source: @Bodhi_Karma_ reply (156 likes, richest comment of the window) on the 13 sep 'gap down, hands itchy' post: set a Tradovate daily-loss-limit auto-liquidate so you physically can't keep going once it's hit.
drafts.why: The single highest-liked comment of the whole window, on a post that already used the complaint-question format that's historically strongest for this account. Reframes a practical tip as a psychology point (willpower isn't the fix, removing the choice is) instead of just repeating the tip.
drafts.why_es: El comentario con más likes de toda la ventana, en un post que ya usaba el formato queja+pregunta, históricamente el más fuerte de esta cuenta. Convierte un consejo práctico en un punto de psicología (la fuerza de voluntad no es el arreglo, quitarte la opción sí) en vez de solo repetir el tip.

drafts.text:
Someone asked me once, what if you didn't need the payout?
I didn't have a good answer.
Need is what gets me in trouble. Need turns a good setup into a rushed one and a rushed one into a revenge trade.
Want can wait for the right entry. Need can't wait for anything.
I keep clicking like I need it. I've never once actually needed it.
drafts.source: Open backlog since 04 sep: @apodochiHQ 'what if you didn't need the payout?' (241 likes) + Jesus's own real reply 'That's the question I should be asking before I click. Need is what gets me in trouble.' (203 likes) - the single richest unused comment exchange on the account, still untouched after 2 weeks.
drafts.why: 444 combined likes sitting unused for two weeks is the biggest gap between value and output on the account right now. Built directly from Jesus's own real words, not invented, matching the pattern that keeps outperforming pure invention.
drafts.why_es: 444 likes combinados sin usar durante dos semanas es la brecha más grande entre valor y salida en la cuenta ahora mismo. Construido directo con las palabras reales del propio Jesus, no inventado, siguiendo el patrón que sigue rindiendo más que la invención pura.

drafts.text:
The market always gives you another setup.
Your account doesn't always give you another shot.
Survive the day. Worry about being right tomorrow.
drafts.source: @Adarsh_Onchain reply (32 likes) on the 13 sep post: 'The market will always give you another opportunity, but your capital won't always give you another chance. Survive first, trade second.'
drafts.why: Keeps the mandatory aphorism slot in rotation with fresh material instead of recycling an old line. Short, no closing question, matches the account's highest-reach format shape even though aphorisms historically under-reach here.
drafts.why_es: Mantiene el espacio obligatorio de aforismo en rotación con material fresco en vez de reciclar una línea vieja. Corto, sin pregunta de cierre, respeta la forma del formato de mayor alcance de la cuenta aunque los aforismos históricamente tengan menos alcance aquí.
